newsitem.title: USA: Coram Healthcare adopts shareholder plan.
newsitem.headline: Coram Healthcare adopts shareholder plan.

text.p: Coram Healthcare said Thursday it adopted a shareholder rights agreement with a 15 percent trigger.

The agreement provides for the distribution of one "right" to buy a unit equal to one one-hundredth of a share of a newly created series of participating preferred stock, to be designated as the "series X preferred stock," for each outstanding share of common stock.

The rights have an exercise price of $10 per right and entitle the stockholder to buy units of series X preferred stock at a discount of 50 percent of the market price of the common stock under certain circumstances.

The agreement provides that if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the outstanding common stock without the approval of the board, the holders of the rights would have the right to purchase units of series X preferred stock having a market value equal to two times the exercise price of the right.
The Rights will be distributed to holders of Coram's common stock of record on July 9.
The company said it is not aware of any takeover attempt.
